title: Production Knowledge Workflow Orchestration Integration
objective: Integrate the existing production Knowledge build, durable query, durable reasoning, and durable insight execution boundaries into the existing production workflow orchestration registry so declared knowledge-build, knowledge-query, knowledge-reasoning, and knowledge-insight workflow steps execute through their authoritative Knowledge services.
architecture: Preserve the existing orchestration engine and workflow execution model as the sole workflow authority.
Register production handlers for knowledge-build, knowledge-query, knowledge-reasoning, and knowledge-insight alongside the existing production Assimilation handler.
Provide an explicit knowledgeGraphRootDirectory production dependency separate from rawSourceRootDirectory.
Use FilesystemKnowledgeGraphPersistence as the durable KnowledgeGraph persistence authority.
Use AssimilationKnowledgeExecution for knowledge-build and durable persistence.
Use existing deterministic Knowledge query, reasoning, and insight engines rather than reproducing their logic in orchestration handlers.
Preserve workflow dependency-output semantics and existing Knowledge result types.
Do not add network, deployment, publication, Git push, deletion, secret access, or unrelated execution authority.
requiredBehavior: knowledge-build consumes the authoritative production Assimilation generated-record source required by AssimilationKnowledgeExecution and persists the resulting KnowledgeGraph under an explicit persistence key.
knowledge-query retrieves the authoritative persisted graph exactly once and executes the existing Knowledge query engine exactly once.
knowledge-reasoning retrieves the authoritative persisted graph exactly once and executes the existing Knowledge reasoning engine exactly once.

knowledge-insight retrieves the authoritative persisted graph exactly once, executes reasoning exactly once, and creates the Insight exactly once using the reasoning result produced by that execution.
Production workflow construction requires an explicit knowledgeGraphRootDirectory rather than reusing rawSourceRootDirectory implicitly.
Existing production Assimilation workflow behavior remains unchanged.
failureSemantics: Knowledge persistence retrieval and persistence failures propagate through the workflow step without replacement.
Knowledge query, reasoning, and insight failures propagate from their authoritative services.
A failed prerequisite Knowledge operation must not execute downstream authoritative operations within that handler.
No handler may broaden workflow, filesystem, network, deployment, publication, or execution authority.
validation: Focused KNOWLEDGE-007 production handler and orchestration tests pass.
TypeScript contains zero Knowledge or KNOWLEDGE-007 diagnostics beyond the exact known unrelated Assimilation baseline.
Final diff contains only the exact KNOWLEDGE-007 specification and implementation/test/export/composition paths required by this integration.
